title: Game developer
intro: Tools that let a coding agent work inside your engine: edit scenes, build levels, make 3D and 2D assets.

picks.name: MCP for Unity

install.label: Unity Package Manager, add from git URL

picks.why: The most starred Unity MCP server. The agent manages assets, controls scenes and edits scripts in your editor.

picks.name: Godot MCP Runtime

install.label: Add to Claude Code
install.cmd: claude mcp add godot -- npx -y godot-mcp-runtime

picks.why: Drives the Godot editor and the running game. Nothing to install into your project, and actively maintained.

picks.name: Unreal Engine skills
picks.why: Published by Epic Games and listed in Anthropic's official plugin marketplace.

picks.name: Unreal Engine MCP

install.label: Add to Claude Code
install.cmd: claude mcp add unreal-engine -- npx -y unreal-engine-mcp-server@beta

picks.why: Controls the Unreal editor: actors, assets, levels. Also needs its Unreal plugin, see its README.

picks.name: Blender MCP

install.label: Add to Claude Code
install.cmd: claude mcp add blender uvx mcp-for-blender

picks.why: Community plugin that drives Blender from a prompt. One of the most starred MCP servers.

picks.name: Aseprite AI Artist
picks.why: The agent paints in the Aseprite window you already have open. MCP server plus skills.

picks.name: Claude Code
picks.why: Every pick above installs into it. Works in the terminal next to your engine.
